verdict.rationale: The ci-cd axis applies to GitHub, which offers GitHub Actions and claims 'secure, reliable CI/CD'. However, the evidence pack never documents deployment environments, approval gates or required reviewers, or tracking which change is deployed where. Generic workflow automation, third-party marketplace deploy apps (Render, Shopify) and protected branches are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define deployment environments with approval gates and track which change is deployed where
